description: This file declares utility functions related to GStreamer Media Source Extensions (MSE) support, specifically for setting up supported capabilities for a GStreamer element class. It includes licensing information, include directives, and a function prototype.
external_methods: gst/gst.h (functions and types from GStreamer library)

methods.name: rialto_mse_sink_setup_supported_caps
methods.description: Sets up the supported capabilities (caps) for a GStreamer element class based on provided MIME types.
